text:
elaine: Quick thread to lock alpha scope for regional routing + tenant isolation. Need must-haves, risks, owners.

priya: Product asks: canary routing, rollback, acceptance tests for geo-failover, simple SLA doc. must be demo-able to customers.

kai: Runtime note: cross-region KV consistency is the main risk. Alpha should use bounded staleness and explicit TTLs; full sync is follow-up.

david: Ops needs quota enforcement and an escape hatch: if tenant policy would exceed capacity, route to platform-default. make it configurable per-tenant.

maria: Sales: we can supply two anchor customers for alpha if we get a migration window + short SLO sheet. also need pricing notes for affinity tiers.

ops-bot: runbook scaffold posted to staging. topology-smoke job scheduled every 2h for alpha smoke.

elaine: Draft alpha launch criteria:
- Policy DSL v1 (validated, readonly)
- Canary routing + console rollback
- Acceptance harness (synthetic geo failover + cutover)
- Runbook tested with 2 tenants in staging
- Metrics: per-route p50/p95, fallback count, quota hits

priya: Acceptance matrix example: single-region outage -> fallback within 500ms; tenant cutover -> zero customer errors; kv-stale -> serve-with-warning. PASS/FAIL gating.

kai: Minimal policy snippet for demos: `policy { match: tenant:T42; intent:[{region:us-west,w:0.9},{region:us-east,w:0.1}]; fallback:platform-default }`

david: Action items: david -> quota+escape-hatch design doc (due 1791234800); kai -> canary plumbing prototype + smoke harness (due 1791235000); priya -> acceptance tests + gating (due 1791234700); maria -> customer list + pricing brief (due 1791234900); ops-bot -> enable runbook jobs (done).

elaine: Agree timeline: Q3 alpha with limited customers, Q4 GA. Call out KV tail latency as primary risk. I'll assemble handoff doc today. Thanks. :tada:
